_comment: Canonical, committed source of every public figure the MONARK site renders (ADR-M004 D1 item 12). Each figure is reproduced verbatim with its qualifier, from a primary [lu] source reading; no second-hand numbers (doc 03). English (ADR-M003 D0.5). Hashed into apps/site/data/manifest.sha256.json and verified at load by apps/site/lib/load-committed.ts (root test/site-honesty.test.ts, test 44). Any figure the site renders MUST originate here (dynamically, via the loader) — a hard-coded numeric literal in a page is a test-44 violation. Adding or altering a figure requires regenerating the manifest.

figures.qualifier: up to; MakerDAO only; for an immediate 43% ETH price decline; state as of block 12,344,944 (2021-04-30)
figures.claim: Collateral that would become liquidatable on MakerDAO under an immediate 43% ETH drop.
figures.source: Qin, Zhou, Gamito, Jovanovic, Gervais — An Empirical Study of DeFi Liquidations (IMC '21)
figures.used_by: Ukemi — target A (liquidatable amount under shock)

figures.qualifier: Aave (V1 and V2), Compound, dYdX, MakerDAO; from each protocol inception to 2021-04-30 (~2 years)
figures.claim: Total collateral liquidated across the four studied platforms.
figures.used_by: context — scale of the liquidation problem

figures.qualifier: 28,138 liquidations by 2,011 liquidators; assumes collateral resold immediately at the oracle price; ~7.9% of liquidated volume
figures.claim: Total liquidator profit over the studied period.
figures.used_by: context — NOT the $800M figure; the archive's '$800M of liquidator gains' was a confusion with liquidated collateral (807.46M), corrected

figures.qualifier: single event; irregular DAI price from the Compound price oracle; November 2020
figures.claim: Liquidator profit enabled by an irregular DAI price on Compound's oracle.
figures.used_by: Shōgen — why an attested price matters; Hikae — oracle-anomaly abstention

figures.qualifier: share of liquidations where the collateral price stays below the liquidation price at the end of a 1,440-block window (liquidator risk, not systemic)
figures.claim: Fraction of liquidations that left the collateral underwater at window end.
figures.used_by: context — execution risk faced by liquidators
